status: prospective measurement definitions for new geometry only
epsilon_scope: Only float32 vertex serialization and arithmetic roundoff in exact target comparisons; not art or geometry tolerance. No percent allowance.

measurement_rules.bounds: World-space complete final Blend vertices and decoded final GLB positions; z min 0; XY envelope centered on origin; glTF coordinate conversion (x,-z,y).

spatter-cone.rim_height_m: Arithmetic mean z of actual crest vertices at 64 equally angled original construction rays. The inner opening boundary is the unique top crest; not a post-hoc height-band selection. Mean 2.5 and max 2.8.
spatter-cone.vent_radius_m: Mean horizontal radius from origin of same crest boundary, 0.65. Not radius at floor.
spatter-cone.vent_floor_m: Protected planar central vent floor z=0.18, including actual closing face.
spatter-cone.outer_radius_m: 3.7 m nominal un-deformed construction foot radius; the final anisotropic irregular foot envelope is 7.8 x 7.4. Not final maximum radius.
spatter-cone.radial_profile_segments: 14 consecutive radial intervals, 15 construction stations from floor center ring through vent crest to foot.
spatter-cone.angular_segments: 64 initial angular rays; optional subsequent triangulation is not a redefinition.
spatter-cone.welded_lobe_groups: 9 distinct angular groups of two staggered continuous surface-relief lobes; connected surface, not nine loose spheres.

travertine-terrace-pools.terrace_levels: 5 main planar pool floors; 4 consecutive rise differences of 0.7 m.
travertine-terrace-pools.pool_rim_relief_m: 0.18 m nominal transverse primary lip contribution before local intended overflow saddle and continuous side-edge relief. Verify actual lip geometry against the frozen deterministic formula, not every edge vertex equal 0.18.
travertine-terrace-pools.width_length: Actual complete XY envelope 10 x 18 m, corrected XY only.
travertine-terrace-pools.total_height: Top surface shifted to max z=4.7; bottom remains z=0 and sidewalls lengthen continuously. No Z scale. Lowest floor-to-bottom offset was not frozen.

visual_scope_unchanged: Broad asymmetric welded mound with recognizable narrow opening, no smooth funnel, bead rings or platform; terrace wide shallow thin-edged connected shelves, no cylinders, bowls or floating shells. New exact diagnostic and final frames required.
stage_separation: Maker results are not independent QA; GPU and composed scene unknown/not run.
view_contract: Eight required 512px individual views plus one lossless contact sheet. Supplemental bottom inspection only where separately identified; sheet is not a ninth camera.
